name: 補足と選択状態を持つ優先設定リスト
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Japanese Lighthouse catalog design candidate LH07-0010 補足と選択状態を持つ優先設定リスト.
Reference hierarchy: ORIGINAL source image(s) control icon glyph geometry, proportions, optical/stroke weight, alignment, spacing and fine control anatomy. Our saved FigCraft mock is secondary for Japanese content and overall layout; do not copy its rough substitute icons or omissions. Official Lighthouse white/forest-green/slate design and locked Japanese typography remain binding.
Input images: Image 1: original-source-reference. Image 2: secondary-component-preview. Image 3: approved-style-reference. The final approved bus style image controls only surface/gradient craft, never content or unrelated icons.
Render ONE priority settings list from original region16,520,358,304 normalized, with7 exact Japanese text runs. Heading 優先する項目 preceded by source's branching route icon. Then five options: おすすめの設定 (SELECTED with checkmark at far right); 操作の少なさ; 見やすさ; 利用しやすさ with smaller supporting line 段差を避けて、使いやすい経路を選びます; 費用の少なさ. All heading and row text Meiryo REGULAR400 logical14px/24px, supporting12px/16px, tracking0. No bold heading. Source ORIGINAL controls heading icon: a common lower vertical stem splits into two upward routes, right branch solid curved arrow, left branch dashed arrow. Do NOT use mock's two horizontal swap arrows. Match source checkmark geometry: simple two joined strokes, not a tick in circle. Adapt selected first label and check to forest green#1F6444; other text ink and heading icon slate#526173. Pure-white canvas; a single subtle white rounded list surface with restrained border/shadow; keep compact spacing and extra room only for support line. No tinted selected row, no new separators if unnecessary, no icons on options, no toggles. Preserve all wording/selection and original list order. Do not import transportation modes, phone chrome or other source content outside crop. Uniform enlargement into readable near-square1400x1300 image with restrained margins.
Official constraints: pure #FFFFFF outer canvas; white rounded cards, fine neutral outlines and soft downward shadows. Primary actions use smooth #174C36 → #1F6444 → #2D8F5E gradient with legible white glyphs/labels and restrained edge light. Ordinary supporting icons #526173 unless a specifically justified group/state overrides. No broad mint, decorative multicolored icons, excessive gloss or invented data/features. Preserve exact Japanese text and existing Meiryo typography, weights, line heights and wrapping. Orthographic clean UI render, no phone/environment, no watermark.
Accent decision: Restore selected-label and check coherence in forest green on white. Keep other labels neutral and heading glyph slate; no decorative fills or extra colors.
reviewNotes: 原版全体/crop/mockを目視。mockの左右交換glyphを採用せず、原版の分岐経路glyphに修正。元の青い選択label+checkの意味を森緑に適応し、mockで失われた選択label色を復元。生成後に7日本語文字列、5選択肢、先頭選択check、accessibility補足、白面とslateを確認。厳密font/寸法一致、操作/native/所有者承認未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
